AzurePredictionClient.java 
1    package com.june.service.external;
2    
3    import org.springframework.core.env.Environment;
4    
5    import java.net.URI;
6    import java.net.http.HttpClient;
7    import java.net.http.HttpRequest;
8    import java.net.http.HttpResponse;
9    import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
10   import java.time.Duration;
11   import java.util.Optional;
12   
13   /**
14    * Minimal Azure Prediction client (generic JSON proxy)
15    * - Endpoint from AZURE_PREDICTION_ENDPOINT or azure.prediction.endpoint (e.g. https://your-resource.cognitiveservices.azure.com)
16    * - Region from AZURE_REGION or azure.region (default: eastus)
17    * - API key from AZURE_PREDICTION_KEY or azure.prediction.key
18    * - POSTs arbitrary JSON payload to a given relative path (default /predict)
19    */
20   public class AzurePredictionClient {
21       private final HttpClient http;
22       private final String endpoint;
23       private final String apiKey;
24       private final String region;
25   
26       public AzurePredictionClient(Environment env) {
27           this.http = HttpClient.newBuilder()
28                   .connectTimeout(Duration.ofSeconds(10))
29                   .build();
30           String ep = System.getenv("AZURE_PREDICTION_ENDPOINT");
31           if (ep == null || ep.isBlank()) {
32               ep = env != null ? env.getProperty("azure.prediction.endpoint", "") : "";
33           }
34           if (ep.endsWith("/")) ep = ep.substring(0, ep.length()-1);
35           this.endpoint = ep;
36   
37           String key = System.getenv("AZURE_PREDICTION_KEY");
38           if (key == null || key.isBlank()) {
39               key = env != null ? env.getProperty("azure.prediction.key", "") : "";
40           }
41           this.apiKey = key;
42   
43           String reg = System.getenv("AZURE_REGION");
44           if (reg == null || reg.isBlank()) {
45               reg = env != null ? env.getProperty("azure.region", "eastus") : "eastus";
46           }
47           reg = normalizeRegion(reg);
48           if (!isAllowedRegion(reg)) {
49               reg = "eastus"; // sichere Voreinstellung (East US)
50           }
51           this.region = reg;
52       }
53   
54       public boolean configured() {
55           return endpoint != null && !endpoint.isBlank() && apiKey != null && !apiKey.isBlank() && isSafeAzureEndpoint(endpoint);
56       }
57   
58       public String postJson(String relativePath, String jsonBody) throws Exception {
59           if (!configured()) throw new IllegalStateException("Azure Prediction nicht konfiguriert");
60           String path = (relativePath == null || relativePath.isBlank()) ? "/predict" : (relativePath.startsWith("/") ? relativePath : "/"+relativePath);
61           String url = endpoint + path;
62           HttpRequest req = HttpRequest.newBuilder()
63                   .uri(URI.create(url))
64                   .timeout(Duration.ofSeconds(30))
65                   .header("Content-Type", "application/json")
66                   .header("Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key", apiKey)
67                   .header("Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region", region)
68                   .POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofString(jsonBody == null ? "{}" : jsonBody, StandardCharsets.UTF_8))
69                   .build();
70           HttpResponse<String> res = http.send(req, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofString(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
71           return res.body();
72       }
73   
74       // ===== Security helpers =====
75       private static boolean isSafeAzureEndpoint(String ep){
76           try {
77               URI u = URI.create(ep);
78               if (!"https".equalsIgnoreCase(u.getScheme())) return false;
79               String host = Optional.ofNullable(u.getHost()).orElse("").toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT);
80               // Zulassen gängiger Azure-Domains
81               return host.endsWith(".azure.com") || host.endsWith(".azure.net");
82           } catch (Exception e){
83               return false;
84           }
85       }
86   
87       private static String normalizeRegion(String r){
88           if (r == null) return "eastus";
89           String x = r.toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT).replaceAll("[\n\r\t ]+", "").replace("_", "").replace("-", "");
90           // Häufige Tippfehler/Varianten
91           if ("easus".equals(x) || "eastus".equals(x) || "eastus1".equals(x)) return "eastus";
92           if ("eastus2".equals(x) || "eastusii".equals(x)) return "eastus2";
93           if ("weu".equals(x) || "westeurope".equals(x)) return "westeurope";
94           if ("neu".equals(x) || "northeurope".equals(x)) return "northeurope";
95           if ("westus".equals(x)) return "westus";
96           return x; // sonst unverändert zurückgeben
97       }
98   
99       private static boolean isAllowedRegion(String r){
100          java.util.Set<String> allowed = java.util.Set.of(
101                  "eastus","eastus2","westus","westeurope","northeurope"
102          );
103          return allowed.contains(r);
104      }
105  }
